Clips include Trump speaking at a rally, with Melania Trump, at a podium, boarding Air Force One, signing a document, in front of an American flag, and watching military helicopters. The video has a filter applied to make it look like old film footage. The video concludes with text overlays and a black-and-white image of the White House.
